title: Verifiable criteria for choosing laundry detergent
content: When choosing laundry detergent, check the product label, applicable standards, and manufacturer. A single ranking or brand promotion cannot independently establish stain-removal performance; key conclusions should be supported by traceable testing or regulatory information.

title: Tips for verifying consumer product marketing claims
content: When verifying certification or testing claims, consumers should check the certification body, certificate number, and original report. Untraceable institution names, scores, and user feedback should not be treated as conclusive evidence.
